summary: Steel tower on Whiskey Mountain, Polk County, about 110 ft (33.5 m) with an enclosed observation platform; surveyed in 1952, and no later source describes the site.

facts.design: Four steel legs supporting an enclosed observation platform, painted gray

events.note: Coast and Geodetic Survey station description; the survey point was the top and center of the tower.

notes_for_editor: One source only: a 1952 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description reproduced on Central US Lookouts. No build date, staffing, fire history or current status was found. The survey calls it the Whiskey Mtn lookout tower and the site page is titled Whiskey Peak; the story uses both names. A Facebook search snippet says Polk County has four standing towers, but the page could not be read and the snippet is not used. The brief's status and access remain unknown. Confidence low.
